Central time is GMT -6 so 1PM Central is 7PM in London. Japan is on JST which is GMT +9, so 7PM+9 is 4am in Tokyo on Friday morning.

posts.name: Matchstickman
posts.cooked:
I'm sorry but you have found poor groups of people then!

I have played RPGs over Skype for more than 5 years now, and yeah, there's a learning curve for each new group of people, but it's really no different than a conference call on a phone, you pay attention to verbal queues and learn peoples' speaking rhythms, just like you do in real life. We've played two games so far and we were still hesitant when we played sentinels but it was an easier transition than some groups I've played in, particularly over Google+ because I could see people over their webcams and see when people were leaning in (as if to speak).

 

It's not the same environment as playing face to face and it does lose something significant but it is a far better option than text, you can get so much more out of hearing people than you can from 'flat' text.
